sources.name: City of Detroit BSEED Building Permits (ArcGIS FeatureServer)
sources.owner: City of Detroit, BSEED via data.detroitmi.gov
sources.license: Detroit Open Data terms of use (open, attribution; verify current text at G0)
sources.attribution: Data: City of Detroit Open Data Portal
sources.notes: Fields include address, permit_type, work_description, estimated contractor cost, zip, neighborhood. No contractor-of-record field in this layer as of 2026-10-24; lane must check the plan-review layer or Accela for contractor data.

sources.name: NOAA Storm Prediction Center daily storm reports (CSV)
sources.update_frequency: continuous; daily files finalized next morning
sources.notes: Files: YYMMDD_rpts_hail.csv, _wind.csv, _torn.csv. Hail size in hundredths of an inch.

sources.name: National Weather Service API (alerts, forecasts, marine)
sources.notes: Requires a descriptive User-Agent (core sets one).

sources.name: OpenFEMA API (disaster declarations, etc.)
sources.license: Public domain; OpenFEMA terms require 'not endorsed by FEMA' notice
sources.attribution: Data from OpenFEMA; this product uses FEMA's API but is not endorsed by FEMA.

sources.name: NOAA National Data Buoy Center realtime observations
sources.attribution: Source: NOAA National Data Buoy Center
sources.notes: Great Lakes buoys are seasonal (pulled Nov-Apr).

sources.name: NOAA CO-OPS Tides & Currents API (Great Lakes water levels)
Great Lakes Observing System / GLERL data
sources.license: GLOS Seagull terms: verify commercial use at G0; GLERL data is public domain
sources.notes: Lane 3 must read GLOS terms before relying on it; GLERL (NOAA) alternatives are public domain.

sources.name: Open-Meteo weather and marine API
sources.license: Free for non-commercial use (CC BY 4.0 data); commercial use requires a paid API plan
sources.notes: Non-commercial only on the free tier. Lanes may evaluate it for G0 but cannot ship on it without a paid plan (ask Nick). NWS is the public-domain alternative.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC VIN decoder API
sources.rate_limit: none published; batch endpoint decodes 50 VINs per POST
sources.notes: VINs identify vehicles, not people; still never store owner data.

sources.name: NHTSA Recalls API (by make/model/year)
sources.notes: No VIN-level open-recall lookup in the public API; that is an NHTSA web tool. Lane 4 must confirm what is possible.

sources.name: Census TIGERweb REST (state, county, ZCTA boundaries)
sources.notes: Used by core.geo for inlined GeoJSON basemaps so prototypes need no tile server. maxAllowableOffset simplifies server-side.

sources.name: NOAA nowcoast MRMS base reflectivity (tiles / WMS)
sources.license: US Government work, public domain; nowcoast asks for attribution and no mission-critical reliance
sources.rate_limit: none published; be gentle, tiles only on user request
sources.notes: Optional raster overlay for Storm Lead. Loaded by the browser, not the fetcher. Verify the current layer name at G1 (nowcoast reorganises).

sources.name: OpenStreetMap standard raster tiles
sources.license: Map data ODbL (attribution required); tile usage policy forbids heavy use and requires a valid User-Agent/Referer
sources.rate_limit: tile policy: light use only, no bulk download
sources.notes: Optional street-detail layer only, off by default; prototypes render from inlined Census GeoJSON. A paid or self-hosted tile provider is a build-plan item, never a prototype dependency.
